fields.name: finderRule
fields.label: Top Line (Optional)
fields.description: The small line above the finder, its two ends split by a |, e.g. 01 / Find your experience | JSW Motors India.

fields.name: finderHeading
fields.label: Finder Heading
fields.description: A short line before the heading (the eyebrow, e.g. The JSW Motors network), the heading (e.g. Find your place.), then a paragraph beside it (e.g. Choose a state, city, and pincode to explore the JSW Motors network near you.).

fields.name: finderHint
fields.label: Finder Note (Optional)
fields.description: The small line under the filters, its parts split by a —, e.g. Filter by location — State · City · Pincode.

fields.name: resultsHeading
fields.label: Results Heading
fields.description: A short line before the heading (the eyebrow, e.g. JSW Motors network), the heading (e.g. Closer to what's next.), then a paragraph: the words beside the dealer count (e.g. Reference listings).

fields.name: closingLine
fields.label: Closing Line (Optional)
fields.description: The small line under the results: a paragraph on the left (e.g. JSW Motors · Network preview) and a link on the right (e.g. Mobility, reimagined).

fields.name: pageSize
fields.label: Dealers per Page
fields.description: How many dealer cards each page of results shows (two per row on desktop).
